Q1: Which commit should `validate.yml:406` pin `setup-runtime` to? Whichever you choose, the answer must include the full 40-hex SHA. Implementation will use it as given and will not derive it.
Choices:
A) The merge commit of PR #7538 on `main`, as GitHub reports it. Paste the 40-hex SHA in the answer. (RECOMMENDED)
B) A later `main` commit whose `.github/actions/setup-runtime/action.yml` already pins `install-codex@91b30f6fba400686c5dded34423f88f1ea10e163`, for example the newest commit that touched that file. Paste the 40-hex SHA in the answer.
C) Don't pin yet. Keep `setup-runtime@stable` and the allow-list entry until a person pins it by hand. This closes the issue without a code change.
